items.name: ArrowOpaqueExpressionOp

items.name: ArrowOpaquePredicate
items.summary: Extension trait for safely turning [`ArrowOpaquePredicateOp`] into an opaque [`Predicate`].

methods.name: arrow_opaque
methods.signature: fn arrow_opaque<T: ArrowOpaquePredicateOp>(op: T, exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Expression>) -> Predicate
methods.summary: Creates a new opaque predicate. See also [`Predicate::opaque`].

items.name: ArrowOpaquePredicateOp
items.summary: An arrow-enhanced opaque predicate op that supports full predicate evaluation over arrow data.
